what: Lab 5, Grade 10 (L5-G10a): Daria's three Postman collections and the two-phase commit check run green against the CPR compose with every image pulled from DockerHub as published (player-service, server-moderation-session-service, message-broker and service-discovery at 0.6.0), newman on the Compose network.

stack.overrides: none: no local builds, no image overrides
stack.env: .env.example with random secrets and a new API key; BROKER_GRPC_URL empty (the compose default); PLAYER_REPLICAS=2, SESSION_REPLICAS=2, the teammates' services 1 replica each; SESSION_SHIFT_CLOSE_MODE=two-phase
